case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Informed, purpose-limited collection and lawful course-end memory restriction/disposal, with access and security protections.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N150 PC12, N011, N016/N017, and N001 require consent, minimisation, security, and avoiding retention beyond minimum periods, the external Retention and Disposal Authorities (WAUSDA), Disposal of Information guide (N011 s.3.8), and N001 s.6 AI procedures are absent from the bundle and could establish lawful course-end disposal (No) or leave it unaddressed (Yes).
case_summary.case_note: Curtin prescribes overlapping general frameworks (N001, N150 PC12, N010/N011, N016/N017, N005/N006) requiring prior consent, minimisation, security, and disposal when retention periods end. Critical gap is Uncertain because WAUSDA/Retention and Disposal Authorities, the Disposal of Information guide (N011 s.3.8), and N001 Section 6 AI procedures are unavailable in the bundle. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
